author: BearCubs
quote: Very good game, genuinely had great experience when I played it back when it released. I think the changes made from the original truly make the experience amazing and I can recommend this game to anyone who is interested.

author: BearCubs
quote: This might be my favorite game of all time. I have no many memories and this is honestly the game I grew up on. I really enjoy speedrunning it but not only that I enjoy casual 100% completions every year. Love this game ️
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: BearCubs
quote: Very much anti-consumerism Israeli-slop. Not only doesn’t it barely run at 30 fps, I couldn’t even play 5 minutes without experiencing game breaking glitches that overall ruin the experience. For being the most hyped up-coming game of all time it is a huge disappointment!

author: BearCubs
quote: The original was my favorite game of all time and after playing the remake I can say it’s near the top. The boss fights feel very improved and overall it’s a very faithful yet new feeling experience at the same time!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
